on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error Propagate - System & Transient Errors

logger.doc:name: Log Transient System Error
logger.message: #["[PAPI ERROR] System/Transient connectivity failure occurred. Flow will propagate for redelivery | Type: " ++ (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "") ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ (vars.correlationId default "")]

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue - Route Non-Retryable to DLQ

logger.doc:name: DEBUG Global Error Handler Entered
logger.message: #[ '[PAPI DEBUG] GLOBAL ERROR HANDLER ENTERED | Type: ' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' | Operation: ' ++ (vars.operation default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | Correlation ID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '') ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- "[PAPI ERROR] Non-retryable failure | Operation: " ++ ((vars.operation default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ ((vars.correlationId default "") as String) ++ " | Error: " ++ ( if (vars.sapiErrorPayload is Object) ( vars.sapiErrorPayload.errorMessage default vars.sapiErrorPayload.description default error.description default "Processing failed" ) else (vars.sapiErrorPayload as String default error.description default "Processing failed") ) as String

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Success
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Successfully published dead-letter payload to DLQ: " ++ (p("amqp.queue") default "") ++ ".dlq | Correlation ID: " ++ (vars.correlationId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log Critical DLQ Publish Failure
logger.message: #["[PAPI CRITICAL] Failed to publish message to DLQ! Check RabbitMQ broker availability. Payload lost: " ++ (write(payload, "application/json") default "")]
